detail.longDescription: 🧵 TechEx26 recap (3/6): 45 people in the agentic AI AuthN/AuthZ session at ACAMP ( https:// spaces.at.internet2.edu/x/9oF8 GQ ) two weeks ago, and nobody had agents with their own identities in production. The case I keep coming back to: an agent in a harness running with the full access of the human who launched it. People can't tell what they're permissioning, and re-prompting just trains them to click yes. This needs a community working group. # IAM # Internet2 # AgenticAI # HigherEd # TechEx26
